records.line: Pico ADC/DSP suite: commands are lowercase, one per line.
preset 0..8: BASIC, IQ-AM, IF-AM, IF-AMSYNC, IF-FM, IF-FSK, USB, LSB, IF-CW
mode basic|am|amsync|fm|usb|lsb|cw; input iq|i|q; tune -12000..12000 Hz
bw 0..4; agc 0=fast 1=medium 2=slow 3=long 4=manual; gain 0..10 (2^n)
volume 0..100; squelch -1=off or 0..12; hang 0..7; swap 0|1; iqcorr 0|1
deemph 0..2; bass/treble 0..4; blanker 0..6; notch/nr 0|1
smooth 1..15; threshold 0=adaptive or 1..6; cw 100..2000 Hz
page 0..4 (4=timing); stream 0|1; status; help. Reboot resets settings and DSP history.
BASIC ignores receiver controls except gain/volume. IF forces swap/iqcorr off.
measure start|stop: all-block timing window; cumulative diagnostics never reset.
